"""Merea — generative AI logo. Organic overlapping petals, neutral tones.
Mark: three asymmetric leaf/blobs rotated about a centre, their overlaps
forming a seed / aperture in negative space. Small 'spore' nodes suggest
generated particles / a neural constellation without tech cliches.
"""
import os
OUT = "output"
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

# Neutral palette
CREAM   = "#F2EDE4"
PAPER   = "#EAE3D6"
STONE   = "#B7AA97"
TAUPE   = "#8A7B68"
CLAY    = "#6E6152"
CHAR    = "#3B362F"
INK     = "#27231E"
SAGE    = "#9A9B8E"   # muted grey-green, still neutral

# One asymmetric petal, tip up, base at centre (100,100) in a 200 box.
# Left edge bulges more than the right -> hand-grown, not geometric.
PETAL = ("M100,102 "
         "C74,84 62,52 78,28 "
         "C86,16 98,10 106,14 "
         "C118,20 124,42 118,64 "
         "C113,82 108,94 100,102 Z")

def mark(cx=100, cy=100, scale=1.0, colors=(STONE, TAUPE, CHAR),
         seed=CREAM, core=CHAR, mono=None, spores=True):
    """Return SVG group for the mark centred at cx,cy."""
    c = [mono]*3 if mono else list(colors)
    # varied rotation/scale per petal keeps it organic, not a pinwheel stamp
    petals = [( -8, 1.00, c[0], 0.92),
              (112, 0.94, c[1], 0.92),
              (232, 1.06, c[2], 0.95)]
    g = [f'<g transform="translate({cx} {cy}) scale({scale}) translate(-100 -100)">']
    for rot, s, col, op in petals:
        g.append(f'<path d="{PETAL}" fill="{col}" fill-opacity="{op}" '
                 f'transform="rotate({rot} 100 100) scale(1)"/>')
        # apply per-petal scale about centre via nested transform on a copy trick:
    g.append('</g>')
    # Rebuild properly with per-petal scale
    g = [f'<g transform="translate({cx} {cy}) scale({scale}) translate(-100 -100)">']
    for rot, s, col, op in petals:
        g.append(f'<g transform="translate(100 100) rotate({rot}) scale({s}) translate(-100 -100)">'
                 f'<path d="{PETAL}" fill="{col}" fill-opacity="{op}"/></g>')
    # seed: negative-space centre + core dot
    g.append(f'<circle cx="100" cy="100" r="13.5" fill="{seed}"/>')
    g.append(f'<circle cx="100" cy="100" r="5.2" fill="{core}"/>')
    if spores:
        sc = mono or CLAY
        for (x, y, r, o) in [(168,42,3.4,.85),(182,66,2.0,.6),(34,150,2.6,.7),
                             (22,128,1.7,.5),(158,168,2.2,.65),(44,38,1.8,.45)]:
            g.append(f'<circle cx="{x}" cy="{y}" r="{r}" fill="{sc}" fill-opacity="{o}"/>')
    g.append('</g>')
    return "\n".join(g)

def svg(w, h, body, bg=None):
    bgrect = f'<rect width="{w}" height="{h}" fill="{bg}"/>' if bg else ""
    return (f'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n'
            f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{w}" height="{h}" '
            f'viewBox="0 0 {w} {h}">\n{bgrect}\n{body}\n</svg>\n')

FONT = "font-family=\"'Avenir Next','Segoe UI',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif\""

def wordmark(x, y, size, color, anchor="start", tag=True, tagcolor=None):
    ls = size*0.34
    t = f'<text x="{x}" y="{y}" {FONT} font-size="{size}" font-weight="300" ' \
        f'letter-spacing="{ls:.1f}" fill="{color}" text-anchor="{anchor}">merea</text>'
    if tag:
        t += (f'\n<text x="{x+2}" y="{y+size*0.62:.0f}" {FONT} font-size="{size*0.205:.0f}" '
              f'font-weight="400" letter-spacing="{size*0.16:.1f}" '
              f'fill="{tagcolor or color}" fill-opacity="0.62" text-anchor="{anchor}">'
              f'GENERATIVE INTELLIGENCE</text>')
    return t

# 1 — Primary horizontal lockup on cream
body = mark(150, 160, 1.15) + "\n" + wordmark(310, 162, 64, INK, tagcolor=CLAY)
open(f"{OUT}/01-merea-primary.svg","w").write(svg(860, 320, body, CREAM))

# 2 — Icon only, transparent (app icon / favicon source)
open(f"{OUT}/02-merea-mark.svg","w").write(svg(400, 400, mark(200,200,1.85)))

# 3 — Stacked lockup on charcoal (dark version, light petals)
body = mark(300, 190, 1.25, colors=(PAPER, STONE, TAUPE), seed=CHAR, core=PAPER) \
     + "\n" + wordmark(312, 410, 52, CREAM, anchor="middle", tagcolor=STONE)
open(f"{OUT}/03-merea-stacked-dark.svg","w").write(svg(600, 500, body, CHAR))

# 4 — Monochrome (single-colour reproduction)
body = mark(150, 160, 1.15, mono=INK, seed="#FFFFFF", core=INK) \
     + "\n" + wordmark(310, 162, 64, INK)
open(f"{OUT}/04-merea-mono.svg","w").write(svg(860, 320, body, "#FFFFFF"))

print("wrote", sorted(os.listdir(OUT)))

arguments.content:
"""Merea — generative AI logo. Organic shapes, neutral tones.
Mark: three irregular 'cell' blobs merging into one growing form; their
translucent overlaps (the generative part) create new tones where they meet,
with a small nucleus in each cell and a bright seed at the shared centre.
"""
import math, os
OUT = "output"; os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

CREAM="#F2EDE4"; PAPER="#EAE3D6"; STONE="#B7AA97"; TAUPE="#8A7B68"
CLAY="#6E6152"; CHAR="#3B362F"; INK="#27231E"

def blob(cx, cy, r, wob, phase=0.0):
    """Closed smooth blob path: radius modulated by two harmonics."""
    pts=[]
    n=9
    for i in range(n):
        a=2*math.pi*i/n
        rr=r*(1+wob[0]*math.sin(2*a+phase)+wob[1]*math.sin(3*a+phase*1.7)+wob[2]*math.cos(a-phase))
        pts.append((cx+rr*math.cos(a), cy+rr*math.sin(a)))
    # Catmull-Rom -> cubic Bezier, closed
    d=f"M{pts[0][0]:.1f},{pts[0][1]:.1f} "
    for i in range(n):
        p0,p1,p2,p3=pts[i-1],pts[i],pts[(i+1)%n],pts[(i+2)%n]
        c1=(p1[0]+(p2[0]-p0[0])/6, p1[1]+(p2[1]-p0[1])/6)
        c2=(p2[0]-(p3[0]-p1[0])/6, p2[1]-(p3[1]-p1[1])/6)
        d+=f"C{c1[0]:.1f},{c1[1]:.1f} {c2[0]:.1f},{c2[1]:.1f} {p2[0]:.1f},{p2[1]:.1f} "
    return d+"Z"

def mark(cx=100, cy=100, scale=1.0, colors=(STONE,TAUPE,CHAR), seed=CREAM,
         mono=None, spores=True):
    c=[mono]*3 if mono else list(colors)
    cells=[(86, 78, 52, (.14,.07,.05), 0.4, c[0]),
           (122, 92, 47, (.11,.09,.06), 2.1, c[1]),
           (96, 126, 50, (.13,.06,.08), 4.0, c[2])]
    op = 0.88 if not mono else 1.0
    g=[f'<g transform="translate({cx} {cy}) scale({scale}) translate(-100 -100)">']
    for x,y,r,w,ph,col in cells:
        g.append(f'<path d="{blob(x,y,r,w,ph)}" fill="{col}" fill-opacity="{op}"/>')
    if mono:  # keep cells legible in 1-colour: paper keylines between them
        for x,y,r,w,ph,col in cells:
            g.append(f'<path d="{blob(x,y,r,w,ph)}" fill="none" stroke="{seed}" stroke-width="2.5"/>')
    # nuclei
    for (x,y,r) in [(76,66,4.2),(134,86,3.4),(88,138,3.8)]:
        g.append(f'<circle cx="{x}" cy="{y}" r="{r}" fill="{seed}" fill-opacity="0.85"/>')
    # seed at the shared centre — where the three cells generate something new
    g.append(f'<circle cx="102" cy="102" r="7" fill="{seed}"/>')
    if spores:
        sc=mono or CLAY
        for (x,y,r,o) in [(176,38,3.2,.8),(188,62,1.9,.55),(20,158,2.4,.65),
                          (12,134,1.6,.45),(168,176,2.0,.6),(30,26,1.7,.4)]:
            g.append(f'<circle cx="{x}" cy="{y}" r="{r}" fill="{sc}" fill-opacity="{o}"/>')
    g.append('</g>')
    return "\n".join(g)

def svg(w,h,body,bg=None):
    b=f'<rect width="{w}" height="{h}" fill="{bg}"/>' if bg else ""
    return (f'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" '
            f'width="{w}" height="{h}" viewBox="0 0 {w} {h}">\n{b}\n{body}\n</svg>\n')

FONT="font-family=\"'Avenir Next','Segoe UI',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif\""
def wordmark(x,y,size,color,anchor="start",tagcolor=None):
    return (f'<text x="{x}" y="{y}" {FONT} font-size="{size}" font-weight="300" '
            f'letter-spacing="{size*0.34:.1f}" fill="{color}" text-anchor="{anchor}">merea</text>\n'
            f'<text x="{x+2}" y="{y+size*0.62:.0f}" {FONT} font-size="{size*0.205:.0f}" font-weight="400" '
            f'letter-spacing="{size*0.16:.1f}" fill="{tagcolor or color}" fill-opacity="0.62" '
            f'text-anchor="{anchor}">GENERATIVE INTELLIGENCE</text>')

open(f"{OUT}/01-merea-primary.svg","w").write(
    svg(860,320, mark(152,160,1.22)+"\n"+wordmark(315,162,64,INK,tagcolor=CLAY), CREAM))
open(f"{OUT}/02-merea-mark.svg","w").write(svg(400,400, mark(200,200,1.9)))
open(f"{OUT}/03-merea-stacked-dark.svg","w").write(
    svg(600,500, mark(300,185,1.3,colors=(PAPER,STONE,TAUPE),seed=CHAR)
        +"\n"+wordmark(312,408,52,CREAM,anchor="middle",tagcolor=STONE), CHAR))
open(f"{OUT}/04-merea-mono.svg","w").write(
    svg(860,320, mark(152,160,1.22,mono=INK,seed="#FFFFFF")
        +"\n"+wordmark(315,162,64,INK), "#FFFFFF"))
print("wrote", sorted(os.listdir(OUT)))

Created **Merea**, a generative-AI logo built from three irregular, pebble-like cells in neutral stone, taupe, and warm charcoal. The cells overlap translucently so new tones emerge where they meet — a quiet metaphor for generation — with small nuclei in each cell, a bright seed at their shared centre, and a few faint “spore” dots drifting outward. The wordmark is set in light, wide-tracked lowercase with a “GENERATIVE INTELLIGENCE” strapline.

Four finished SVGs are in `./output/`:

- `01-merea-primary.svg` — horizontal lockup on cream
- `02-merea-mark.svg` — icon only, transparent background
- `03-merea-stacked-dark.svg` — stacked lockup on charcoal
- `04-merea-mono.svg` — single-colour version with keylines separating the cells

The generator source is kept in `src/make_logo.py` (the blob outlines are generated from harmonic radius modulation, smoothed into Bézier curves), and all four SVGs were rendered, visually inspected, and validated as well-formed XML.
